apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store links, numeric app IDs, or app names (the top search match is used). Up to 500 per run.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes such as us, gb, de (reviews are per country). Default: the country in the link, otherwise us. Up to 20.

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Maximum reviews per app and country
maxReviewsPerApp.description: Most recent first. Apple's feed provides at most 500 per country. 0 = app details only.
